sections.title_en: What Has Come Regarding the Virtue of Kindness to Parents
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي فَضْلِ بِرِّ الوَالِدَيْنِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 104
entries.isnad_ar: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو يَعْلَى حَمْزَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ العَزِيزِ المُهَلَّبِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ ابْنِ دِلُّويَهْ الدَّقَّاقُ ؒ فِي شُهُورِ سَنَةَ (328) حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ البُخَارِيُّ، أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الجُعْفِيُّ، قَالَ:
entries.isnad_en: In the name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate. Abu Ya'la Hamzah b. Abd al-Aziz al-Muhallabi informed us, Abu Bakr Muhammad b. Ahmad b. Dilluyah ad-Daqqaq ؒ in the months of the year 328 AH, narrated to us Muhammad b. Isma'il al-Bukhari, Abu Abdillah al-Ju'fi, who said

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 105
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الوَلِيدِ هِشَامُ بْنُ عَبْدِ المَلِكِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الوَلِيدِ بْنِ العَيْزَارِ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيَّ ، يَقُولُ: أَخْبَرَنَا صَاحِبُ هَذِهِ الدَّارِ، وَأَوْمَأَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى دَارِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَعْنِي: ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ ﵁ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "سَأَلتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ: أَيُّ العَمَلِ أَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى؟ قَالَ: الصَّلَاةُ عَلَى وَقْتِهَا" قُلْتُ: ثُمَّ أَيٌّ؟ قَالَ: "ثُمَّ بِرُّ الوَالِدَيْنِ. قُلْتُ: ثُمَّ أَيٌّ؟ قَالَ: "الجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ" قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي بِهِنَّ، وَلَوِ اسْتَزَدْتُهُ لَزَادَنِي) .
entries.isnad_en: Abu al-Walid Hisham b. Abd al-Malik narrated to us, Shu'bah narrated to us, from al-Walid b. al-'Ayzar, I heard Abu Amr ash-Shaibani say: The owner of this house informed us—and he gestured with his hand toward the house of Abdullah, meaning Ibn Mas'ud ؓ—he said
entries.matn_en: "I asked the Prophet ﷺ: 'Which deed is most beloved to God ﷻ?' He said: 'Prayer at its proper time.'" I said 'Then which?' He said: 'Then kindness to parents.' I said: 'Then which?' He said: 'Jihad in the way of God.' He said: 'He told me these, and if I had asked him for more, he would have given me more.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 107
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا الوَلِيدُ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيَّ، [أَخْبَرَنَا] صَاحِبُ هَذِهِ الدَّارِ، يَعْنِي دَّارَ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِثْلَهُ .
entries.isnad_en: Adam b. Abi Iyas narrated to us, Shu'bah narrated to us, al-Walid narrated to us, I heard Abu Amr ash-Shaibani [inform us] from the owner of this house, meaning the house of Ibn Mas'ud, who said
entries.matn_en: I asked the Messenger of God ﷺ the same as above.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 107
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا المَسْعُودِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ العَيْزَارِ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيِّ: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: (سَأَلتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ: أَيُّ الأَعْمَالِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ: "الصَّلَاةُ [لِوَقْتِهَا] "، قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَاذَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: "ثُمَّ بِرُّ الوَالِدَيْنِ" قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَاذَا؟ قَالَ: "الجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ" ثُمَّ سَكَتَ، وَلَوْ اسْتَزَدْتُهُ لَزَادَنِي" .
entries.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us, al-Mas'udi narrated to us, Ibn al-'Ayzar narrated to me, from Abu Amr ash-Shaibani: from Abdullah, who said:
entries.matn_en: (I asked the Messenger of God ﷺ: 'Which deeds are the best?' He said: 'Prayer [at its proper time],' then he said: 'What comes next, O Messenger of God?' He said: 'Then kindness to parents.' He said: 'Then what?' He said: 'Jihad in the way of God.' Then he fell silent, and if I had asked him for more, he would have given me more.')

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 108
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الحَسَنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللهِ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيِّ: عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: "أَفْضَلُ الأَعْمَالِ أَوِ العَمَلِ الصَّلَاةُ لِوَقْتِهَا، وَبِرُّ الوَالِدَيْنِ" .
entries.isnad_en: Qutaybah b. Sa'id narrated to us, Jarir narrated to us, from al-Hasan b. Ubaydullah, from Abu Amr ash-Shaibani: from Ibn Mas'ud, who said
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'The best of deeds—or the deed—is prayer at its proper time, and kindness to parents.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 109
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنِي قَيْسُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا الحَسَنُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللهِ ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: "أَفْضَلُ العَمَلِ: الصَّلَاةُ لِوَقْتِهَا، وَالجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ" .
entries.isnad_en: Qays b. Hafs narrated to me, Abd al-Wahid narrated to us, al-Hasan b. Ubaydullah narrated to us, from Abu Amr: from Abdullah, who said
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'The best of deeds is prayer at its proper time and jihad in the way of God.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 110
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ البُخَارِيُّ: وَرَوَاهُ عُبَيْدٌ المُكَتِّبُ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ .
entries.isnad_en: Al-Bukhari said And Ubayd al-Mukattib narrated it from Abu Amr ash-Shaibani, from a man among the companions of the Prophet ﷺ.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 111
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ: عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "سَأَلتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ: أَيُّ الأَعْمَالِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ: "الصَّلَاةُ ، وَبِرُّ الوَالِدَيْنِ، وَالجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ" وَلَوْ اسْتَزَدْتُهُ لَزَادَنِي) .
entries.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us, from Isra'il, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu al-Ahwas: from Ibn Mas'ud, who said
entries.matn_en: 'I asked the Prophet ﷺ: 'Which deeds are the best?' He said: 'Prayer, kindness to parents, and jihad in the way of God,' and if I had asked him for more, he would have given me more.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 112
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، وَمُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَا: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ العَزِيزِ، يَعْنِي: ابْنَ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ
entries.matn_ar: بِهَذَا .
entries.isnad_en: Abu an-Nu'man and Musa b. Isma'il narrated to us, they said Abd al-Aziz—meaning Ibn Muslim—narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Ibn Mas'ud, from the Prophet ﷺ
entries.matn_en: with this.

sections.title_en: Kindness to Parents Even If They Are Polytheists
sections.title_ar: بَابُ بِرِّ الوَالِدَيْنِ وَإِنْ كَانَا مُشْرِكيْنِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 113
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، حَدَّثَنَا سِمَاكٌ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ ﵁ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: (نَزَلَتْ فِيَّ أَرْبَعُ آيَاتٍ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللهِ ﷻ: حَلَفَتْ أُمِّي أَنْ لَا تَأْكُلَ وَلَا تَشْرَبَ حَتَّى تُفَارِقَ مُحَمَّدًا ﷺ، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: {وَإِنْ جَاهَدَاكَ عَلَى أَنْ تُشْرِكَ بِي مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ فَلَا تُطِعْهُمَا وَصَاحِبْهُمَا فِي الدُّنْيَا مَعْرُوفًا} ، وَالثَّانِيَةُ: أَنِّي كُنْتُ أَخَذْتُ سَيْفًا فَأَعْجَبَنِي، فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَبْ لِي هَذَا، فَنَزَلَتْ: {يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْأَنْفَالِ} ، وَالثَّالِثَةُ: أَنِّي كُنْتُ مَرِضْتُ، فَأَتَانِي النَّبِيُّ ﷺ، فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَقْسِمَ مَالِي، أَفَأُوصِي بِالنِّصْفِ؟ قَالَ: "لَا" فَقُلْتُ: الثُّلُثُ؟ فَسَكَتَ، فَكَانَ الثُّلُثُ بَعْدُ جَائِزًا ، وَالرَّابِعَةُ: إِنِّي شَرِبْتُ الخَمْرَ مَعَ قَوْمٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ، فَضَرَبَ رَجُلٌ مِنْهُمْ أَنْفِي بِلَحْيِ جَمَلٍ ، فَأَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَأَنْزَلَ ﷻ تَحْرِيمَ الخَمْرِ .
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. Umar b. Yusuf narrated to us, Isra'il narrated to us, Simak narrated to us, from Mus'ab b. Sa'd, from his father, Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas ؓ, who said
entries.matn_en: (Four verses from the Book of God ﷻ, were revealed concerning me: My mother swore that she would neither eat nor drink until she abandoned Muhammad ﷺ so God ﷻ revealed: {And if they strive to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them, but accompany them in this world with appropriate kindness}. The second: I had taken a sword that pleased me, so I said: 'O Messenger of God, give this to me,' and the verse was revealed: {They ask you about the spoils of war}. The third I fell ill, and the Prophet ﷺ came to me, so I said 'O Messenger of God, I wish to distribute my wealth, shall I bequeath half?' He said: 'No.' I said: 'A third?' He remained silent, and a third was later permitted. The fourth: I drank wine with a group of the Ansar, and one of them struck my nose with the jawbone of a camel, so I came to the Prophet ﷺ and God ﷻ, revealed the prohibition of wine.)

sections.title_en: Parents Are the Most Entitled to Companionship
sections.title_ar: بَابُ الوَالِدَيْنِ أَحَقُّ النَّاسِ بِالصُّحْبَةِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 116
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ القَعْقَاعِ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: ([قَالَ] رَجُلٌ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَنْ أَحَقُّ النَّاسِ بِالصُّحْبَةِ؟ قَالَ: "أُمُّكَ" قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَهْ ؟ قَالَ: "ثُمَّ أُمُّكَ" قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَهْ؟ قَالَ: "أَبَاكَ". قَالَ : فَيَرَوْنَ أَنَّ لِأُمِّكَ الثُّلُثَيْنِ، وَلِأَبِيكَ الثُّلُثَ. قِيْلَ لِسُفْيَانَ: [لِلأُمِّ الثُّلُثَانِ] فِي الحَدِيثِ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ شُبْرُمَةَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عُمَارَةَ قَبْلَ [أَنْ] أَرَاهُ، [فَـ] سَأَلتُ عُمَارَةَ، فَجَاءَ بِهِ .
entries.isnad_en: Ali b. Abdullah narrated to us, Sufyan narrated to us, from Umarah b. al-Qa'qa', from Abu Zur'ah: from Abu Hurayrah ؓ, who said
entries.matn_en: ([A man] said: 'O Messenger of God, who is most entitled to companionship?' He said: 'Your mother.' He said: 'Then who?' He said: 'Then your mother.' He said: 'Then who?' He said: 'Your father.' They consider that the mother has two-thirds and the father one-third. Sufyan was asked: '[Does the mother have two-thirds] in the hadith?' He said: 'Yes, I heard Ibn Shubrumah narrate from Umarah before I saw him, [then] I asked Umarah, and he confirmed it.')

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 118
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ [بْنِ القَعْقَاعِ] بْنِ شُبْرُمَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: (جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَنْ أَحَقُّ بِحُسْنِ صَحَابَتِي ؟ قَالَ: "أُمُّكَ" قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَنْ؟ قَالَ: "أُمُّكَ" قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَنْ؟ قَالَ: "أُمُّكَ" قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَنْ؟ قَالَ: "أَبُوكَ") .
entries.isnad_en: Qutaybah narrated to us, Jarir narrated to us, from Umarah [ibn al-Qa'qa'] b. Shubrumah, from Abu Zur'ah: from Abu Hurayrah ؓ who said
entries.matn_en: (A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: 'O Messenger of God, who is most entitled to my good companionship?' He said: 'Your mother.' He said: 'Then who?' He said: 'Your mother.' He said: 'Then who?' He said: 'Your mother.' He said: 'Then who?' He said: 'Your father.')

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 119
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ ابْنِ شُبْرُمَةَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا زُرْعَةَ: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "قِيلَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَنْ أَبَرُّ؟ قَالَ: "أُمَّكَ" قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَنْ؟ قَالَ: "أُمَّكَ" قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَنْ؟ قَالَ: "ثُمَّ أُمَّكَ" قَالَ: ثُمَّ مَنْ؟ قَالَ: "ثُمَّ أَبَاكَ" .
entries.isnad_en: Sulayman b. Harb narrated to us, Wuhayb b. Khalid narrated to us, from Ibn Shubrumah, who said: I heard Abu Zur'ah, from Abu Hurayrah, who said
entries.matn_en: 'It was said: 'O Messenger of God, whom should I treat with the most kindness?' He said: "Your mother." He said: 'Then who?' He said: "Your mother." He said: 'Then who?' He said: "Then your mother." He said: 'Then who?' He said: "Then your father."'

sections.title_en: Jihad with the Permission of Muslim Parents
sections.title_ar: بَابُ الجِهَادِ بِإِذْنِ الأَبَوَيْنِ المُسْلِمَيْنِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 121
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، عَنْ حَبِيبٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي العَبَّاسِ : عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: (قَالَ رَجُلٌ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ أُجَاهِدُ؟ قَالَ: "لَكَ أَبَوَانِ؟ " قَالَ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: "فَفِيهِمَا فَجَاهِدْ " .
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. Kathir narrated to us, Sufyan informed us, from Habib, from Abu al-‘Abbas: from ‘Abdullah b. ‘Amr, who said
entries.matn_en: (A man said to the Prophet ﷺ: 'Shall I go out for jihad?' He said: 'Do you have parents?' He said: 'Yes.' He said: 'Then strive in serving them.')

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 123
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ : عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: (جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ يُبَايِعُهُ عَلَى الهِجْرَةِ، وَتَرَكَ أَبَوَيْهِ يَبْكِيَانِ، قَالَ: "ارْجِعْ إِلَيْهِمَا، فَأَضْحِكْهُمَا كَمَا أَبْكَيْتَهُمَا") .
entries.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us, Sufyan informed us, from 'Ata' b. al-Sa'ib, from his father, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Amr, who said
entries.matn_en: (A man came to the Prophet ﷺ to pledge allegiance to him for emigration (hijrah), having left his parents weeping. He said: 'Return to them, and make them laugh just as you made them weep.')

sections.title_en: The Greatest Bond Is Kindness to Parents
sections.title_ar: بَابُ أَعْظَمِ الصِّلَةِ، صِلَةُ الوَالِدَيْنِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 129
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ :
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: "مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ ، وَيُنْسَأَ [لَهُ] فِي أَثَرِهِ ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ" .
entries.isnad_en: Yahya b. Bukayr narrated to us, al-Layth narrated to us, from Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, Anas b. Malik informed me:
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ said 'Whoever wishes to have his provision expanded and his lifespan prolonged, let him maintain his ties of kinship.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 131
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الخُزَاعِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا حَزْمُ بْنُ أَبِي حَزْمٍ القُطَعِيُّ ، سَمِعْتُ مَيْمُونَ بْنَ سِيَاهٍ، سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: "مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُمَدَّ لَهُ فِي عُمْرِهِ، وَيُزَادَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ، فَلْيَبَرَّ وَالِدَيْهِ" .
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. Sa'id al-Khuza'i narrated to us, Harzam b. Abi Harzam al-Quta'i narrated to us, I heard Maymun b. Siyah say, I heard Anas say:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said 'Whoever wishes to have his lifespan extended and his provision increased, let him be kind to his parents.'

sections.title_en: The Supplication of Parents Is Answered
sections.title_ar: بَابُ دَعْوَةِ الوَالِدَيْنِ مُسْتَجَابَةٌ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 134
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: "ثَلَاثُ دَعَوَاتٍ مُسْتَجَابَاتٌ لَهُنَّ، لَا شَكَّ فِيهِنَّ : دَعْوَةُ المَظْلُومِ، وَدَعْوَةُ المُسَافِرِ، وَدَعْوَةُ الوَالِدِ عَلَى وَلَدِهِ" .
entries.isnad_en: Mu'adh b. Fadalah narrated to us, Hisham narrated to us, from Yahya b. Abi Kathir, from Abu Ja'far, that he heard Abu Hurayrah say:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ said 'Three supplications are undoubtedly answered: the supplication of the oppressed, the supplication of the traveler, and the supplication of a parent against his child.'

sections.title_en: Disobedience to Parents Nullifies Deeds
sections.title_ar: بَابُ عُقُوقِ الوَالِدَيْنِ يُحْبِطُ العَمَلَ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 139
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ شُعَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ النَّصْرِيُّ ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَّامٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ البَاهِلِيِّ ﵁ ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "ثَلَاثَةٌ لَا يَقْبَلُ اللهُ مِنْهُمْ صَرْفًا وَلَا عَدْلًا: عَاقٌّ، وَمَنَّانٌ، وَمُكَذِّبٌ بِقَدَرٍ" .
entries.isnad_en: Bishr b. Muhammad informed us, Abdullah informed us, Muhammad b. Shu'ayb informed us, Umar b. Yazid an-Nasri narrated to me, from Abu Sallam, who informed him from Abu Umamah al-Bahili ؓ, from the Messenger of God ﷺ who said
entries.matn_en: 'Three (people) from whom God will accept neither ṣarf nor ʿadl (neither obligatory nor voluntary deeds, in one explanation; repentance and ransom, in another): the one who is disobedient to his parents, the one who reminds others of his favors, and the one who denies the divine decree (qadar).'

sections.title_en: The Recompense for Parents
sections.title_ar: بَابُ جَزَاءِ الوَالِدَيْنِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 143
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "لَا يَجْزِي وَلَدٌ وَالِدَهُ ، إِلَّا أَنْ يَجِدَهُ مَمْلُوكًا فَيَشْتَرِيَهُ فَيُعْتِقَهُ ".
entries.isnad_en: Qabisah b. 'Uqbah narrated to us, Sufyan narrated to us, from Suhayl b. Abi Salih, from his father, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ who said
entries.matn_en: "A child cannot fully repay his parent unless he finds him as a slave and then buys and frees him."

sections.title_en: Disobedience to Parents Is Among the Major Sins
sections.title_ar: بَابُ عُقُوقِ الوَالِدَيْنِ مِنَ الكَبَائِرِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 148
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ المُفَضَّلِ، حَدَّثَنَا الجُرَيْرِيُّ: عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: ("أَلَا أُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِأَكْبَرِ الكَبَائِرِ؟ " ثَلَاثًا، قَالُوا: بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: "الإِشْرَاكُ بِاللَّهِ، وَعُقُوقُ الوَالِدَيْنِ" وَجَلَسَ وَكَانَ مُتَّكِئًا ، فَقَالَ: "وَقَوْلُ الزُّورِ"، قَالَ: فَمَا زَالَ يُكَرِّرُهَا حَتَّى قُلْنَا: لَيْتَهُ سَكَتَ) .
entries.isnad_en: Musaddad narrated to us, Bishr b. al-Mufaddal narrated to us, al-Jurayri narrated to us, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Bakrah, from his father, who said
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Shall I not inform you of the greatest of major sins?" (He said this) three times. They said: "Yes, O Messenger of God." He said: "Associating partners with God and disobedience to parents." He was reclining, then he sat up and said: "And false testimony." He kept repeating it until we said: "We wish he would stop."

sections.title_en: Whoever Finds His Parents Yet Does Not Enter Paradise
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ وَالِدَيْهِ فَلَمْ يَدْخُلِ الجَنَّةَ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 150
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سُهَيْلٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "رَغِمَ أَنْفُهُ ، رَغِمَ أَنْفُهُ، رَغِمَ أَنْفُهُ"، قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَنْ؟ قَالَ: "مَنْ أَدْرَكَ وَالِدَيْهِ عِنْدَ الكِبْرِ، أَوْ أَحَدَهُمَا، فَدَخَلَ النَّارَ" .
entries.isnad_en: Khalid b. Makhlad narrated to us, Sulayman b. Bilal narrated to us, Suhayl narrated to me, from his father, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ who said
entries.matn_en: "May his nose be rubbed in the dust, may his nose be rubbed in the dust, may his nose be rubbed in the dust." They said: "O Messenger of God, who?" He said: "Whoever finds his parents in their old age, or one of them, and then enters the Fire."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 151
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الفَضْلِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "رَغِمَ أَنْفُهُ، رَغِمَ أَنْفُهُ، رَغِمَ أَنْفُهُ، ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، مَنْ أَدْرَكَ وَالِدَيْهِ أَوْ أَحَدَهُمَا، عِنْدَ الكِبَرِ فَيَدْخُلِ النَّارَ، أَوْ لَمْ يَدْخُلِ الجَنَّةَ" .
entries.isnad_en: Abu al-Nu'man Muhammad b. al-Fadl narrated to us, Abu 'Awanah narrated to us, from Suhayl b. Abi Salih, from his father, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ who said
entries.matn_en: "May his nose be rubbed in the dust, may his nose be rubbed in the dust, may his nose be rubbed in the dust—three times—whoever finds his parents, or one of them, in their old age and then enters the Fire or does not enter Paradise."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 151
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ المُفَضَّلِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ المَقْبُرِيِّ: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "رَغِمَ أَنْفُ رَجُلٍ ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيَّ، وَرَغِمَ أَنْفُ رَجُلٍ أَدْرَكَ أَبَوَيْهِ عِنْدَ الكِبَرِ، أَوْ أَحَدَهُمَا، فَلَمْ يُدْخِلَاهُ الجَنَّةَ، وَرَغِمَ أَنْفُ رَجُلٍ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ رَمَضَانُ ثُمَّ انْسَلَخَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُغْفَرَ لَهُ" .
entries.isnad_en: Musaddad narrated to us, Bishr b. al-Mufaddal narrated to us, 'Abd al-Rahman b. Ishaq narrated to us, from Sa'id al-Maqburi, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ who said:
entries.matn_en: "May the nose of a man be rubbed in the dust if I am mentioned in his presence and he does not invoke blessings upon me. May the nose of a man be rubbed in the dust if he finds his parents in their old age, or one of them, and they do not admit him to Paradise. May the nose of a man be rubbed in the dust if Ramadan enters upon him and then departs before he is forgiven."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 154
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي أُوَيْسٍ ، حَدَّثَنِي أَخِي ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بِلَالٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ السَّالِمِيِّ ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ إِنَّ كَعْبَ بْنَ عُجْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: "احْضَرُوا المِنْبَرَ" فَلَمَّا خَرَجَ فَرَقِيَ المِنْبَرَ، فَرَقِيَ أَوَّلَ دَرَجَةٍ مِنْهُ قَالَ: "آمِينَ". ثُمَّ رَقِيَ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ، فَقَالَ: "آمِينَ". ثُمَّ لَمَّا رَقِيَ الثَّالِثَةَ، قَالَ: "آمِينَ". فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ وَنَزَلَ عَنِ المِنْبَرِ، قُلْنَا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: لَقَدْ سَمِعْنَا مِنْكَ اليَوْمَ شَيْئًا مَا كُنَّا نَسْمَعُهُ مِنْكَ، قَالَ: "وَسَمِعْتُمُوهُ؟ ". قُلْنَا: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: "إِنَّ جِبْرِيلَ ؑ اعْتَرَضَ "، قَالَ: "بَعُدَ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَمَضَانَ فَلَمْ يُغْفَرْ لَهُ، فَقُلْتُ: آمِينَ، فَلَمَّا رَقَيْتُ الثَّانِيَةَ"، قَالَ: "بَعُدَ مَنْ ذُكِرْتَ عِنْدَهُ، فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْكَ، فَقُلْتُ: آمِينَ، فَلَمَّا رَقَيْتُ الثَّالِثَةَ"، قَالَ: "بَعُدَ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ عِنْدَهُ أَبَوَاهُ الكِبَرَ، أَوْ أَحَدَهُمَا، فَلَمْ يُدْخِلَاهُ الجَنَّةَ، فَقُلْتُ: آمِينَ") .
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Abi Uways narrated to us, my brother narrated to me, from Sulayman b. Bilal, from Muhammad b. Hilal, from Sa'd b. Ishaq b. Ka'b b. 'Ujrah al-Salimi, from his father, who said Indeed, Ka'b b. 'Ujrah ؓ said:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Bring the pulpit." When he came out, he ascended the pulpit. He ascended the first step and said: "Amen." Then he ascended the second step and said: "Amen." Then when he ascended the third step, he said: "Amen." When he finished and descended from the pulpit, we said "O Messenger of God, today we have heard from you something we have never heard before." He said: "Did you hear it?" We said: "Yes." He said: "Gabriel (ﷺ) came to me and said: 'May he be far removed from mercy who finds Ramadan and is not forgiven.' So I said: 'Amen.' Then when I ascended the second step,' he said: 'May he be far removed from mercy if you are mentioned in his presence and he does not invoke blessings upon you.' So I said: 'Amen.' Then when I ascended the third step,' he said: 'May he be far removed from mercy who finds his parents in their old age, or one of them, and they do not admit him to Paradise.' So I said: 'Amen.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 157
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ بْنُ وَرْدَانَ، سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: (ارْتقَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَى المِنْبَرِ فَرَقِى دَرَجَةً، فَقَالَ: "آمِينَ. ثُمَّ ارْتقَى دَرَجَةً، فَقَالَ: "آمِينَ". ثُمَّ ارْتَقَى الدَّرَجَةَ الثَّالِثَةَ، فَقَالَ: "آمِينَ". ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى فَجَلَسَ، فَقَالَ أَصْحَابُهُ: عَلَى مَا أَمَّنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: "أَتَانِي جِبْرِيلُ ؑ، فَقَالَ: رَغِمَ أَنْفُ امْرِئٍ ذُكِرْتُ عِنْدَهُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْكَ، فَقُلْتُ: آمِينَ. وَرَغِمَ أَنْفُ امْرِئٍ أَدْرَكَ أَبَوَاهُ أَوْ أَحَدَهُمَا، لَمْ يَدْخُلِ الجَنَّةَ، فَقُلْتُ: آمِينَ") .
entries.isnad_en: Abu Nu'aym narrated to us, Salamah b. Wardan narrated to us, I heard Anas say:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ ascended the pulpit and climbed a step, then said "Amen." Then he climbed another step and said: "Amen." Then he climbed the third step and said: "Amen." Then he sat down, and his companions said: "For what did you say 'Amen,' O Messenger of God?" He said: "Gabriel (ﷺ) came to me and said: 'May the nose of a man be rubbed in the dust if you are mentioned in his presence and he does not invoke blessings upon you.' So I said: 'Amen.' 'And may the nose of a man be rubbed in the dust if he finds his parents, or one of them, and does not enter Paradise.' So I said: 'Amen.'"

sections.title_en: A Parent’s Gaze at Their Child
sections.title_ar: بَابُ نَظَرِ الوَالِدِ لِوَلَدِهِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 160
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ: وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ، عَنِ الحَكَمِ بْنِ أَبَانَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ: عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: "إِذَا نَظَرَ الوَالِدُ إِلَى وَلَدِهِ فَسَّرَهُ كَانَ لِلوَلَدِ عِتْقُ نَسَمَةٍ " .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated to us ‘Abdullah b. Salih, narrated to me Al-Layth, narrated to me Ibrahim b. A‘yan. ‘Abdullah b. Salih said And I heard it from Ibrahim as well, from Al-Hakam b. Aban, from ‘Ikrimah, from Ibn ‘Abbas, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "When a parent looks at his child and it pleases him, the child receives [the reward of] freeing a soul."

sections.title_en: Kindness to Those Whom One's Father Used to Maintain Ties With
sections.title_ar: بَابُ بِرِّ مِنْ كَانَ يَصِلُهُ أَبُوهُ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 162
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ المُقْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عُثْمَانَ الوَلِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي الوَلِيدِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "إِنَّ أَبَرَّ البِرِّ أَنْ يَصِلَ الرَّجُلُ أَهْلَ وُدِّ أَبِيهِ" .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated to us ‘Abdullah b. Yazid Al-Muqri’, narrated to us Haywah, narrated to me Abu ‘Uthman Al-Walid b. Abi Al-Walid, from ‘Abdullah b. Dinar, from Ibn ‘Umar, from the Messenger of God ﷺ who said
entries.matn_en: "The most righteous act of kindness is for a man to maintain ties with those who were his father's friends and loved ones."

sections.title_en: What Has Come Regarding the Sin of Severing Kinship Ties
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي إِثْمِ قَاطِعِ الرَّحِمِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 164
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ بْنِ قُسَيْطٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ المُسَيِّبِ: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ الرَّحِمَ شُجْنَةً ، وَقَالَ: أَمَا تَرْضَيْنَ أَنْ أُدْخِلَ الجَنَّةَ مَنْ وَصَلَكِ؟ وَأُدْخِلَ النَّارَ مَنْ قَطَعَكِ" .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated to us ‘Ali b. ‘Abdullah, narrated to us Anas b. ‘Iyad, narrated to me ‘Abdullah b. Yazid b. Qusayt, from his father, from Sa‘id b. Al-Musayyib, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ who said
entries.matn_en: "God created kinship as a branch (shujna), and said to it: Are you not pleased that I admit into Paradise those who maintain you and admit into the Fire those who sever you?"

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 167
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ، وَمُحَمَّدٍ، سَمِعَا الزُّهْرِيَّ: عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ: "لَا يَدْخُلُ الجَنَّةَ قَاطِعٌ" .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated to us Abu Al-Walid, narrated to us Shu‘bah, from Sufyan b. Husayn and Muhammad, who heard Az-Zuhri, from Muhammad b. Jubayr b. Mut‘im, from his father,
entries.matn_en: that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say: "The one who severs ties will not enter Paradise."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 168
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الوَلِيدِ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، [عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ] ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ
entries.matn_ar: مِثْلَهُ .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated to us Abu Al-Walid, informed us Sufyan b. ‘Uyaynah, [from Az-Zuhri], from Ibn Jubayr, from his father, from the Prophet ﷺ
entries.matn_en: with the same narration.

sections.title_en: Whoever Is Blessed in Their Lifespan and Provision Due to Maintaining Kinship Ties
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مَنْ بُورِكَ لَهُ فِي عُمُرِهِ وَرِزْقِهِ لِصِلَةِ رَحِمِهِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 170
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ: عَنْ أَنَسٍ ﵁،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: "مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ ، وَيُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ" .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated to us ‘Abdullah b. Salih, narrated to us Al-Layth, narrated to me ‘Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, from Anas ؓ
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ said "Whoever wishes for their provision to be expanded and their lifespan extended, let them maintain their kinship ties."

sections.title_en: Mention of Kinship Complaining to God ﷻ
sections.title_ar: بَابُ ذِكْرِ تَشَكِّي الرَّحِمِ إِلَى اللَّهِ ﷻ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 172
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، [حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الجَبَّارِ، سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ كَعْبٍ]، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "إِنَّ الرَّحِمَ شُجْنَةٌ [مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ] ، تَقُولُ: يَا رَبِّ، إِنِّي ظُلِمْتُ، إِنِّي قُطِعْتُ، يَا رَبِّ، يَا رَبِّ، يَا رَبِّ، فَيُجِيبُهَا، أَلَا تَرْضَيْنَ أَنْ أَقْطَعَ مَنْ قَطَعَكِ، وَأَصِلَ مَنْ وَصَلَكِ؟ " .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated to us Hajjaj b. Minhal, [narrated to us Shu‘bah, informed me Muhammad b. ‘Abd Al-Jabbar, I heard Muhammad b. Ka‘b], that he heard Abu Hurayrah narrate from the Messenger of God ﷺ who said
entries.matn_en: "Kinship is a branch from the Most Merciful. It says: O Lord, I have been wronged; I have been severed. O Lord, O Lord, O Lord. He responds: Are you not pleased that I sever those who sever you and maintain those who maintain you?"

sections.title_en: The Reward of Disobedience and Severing Kinship Ties
sections.title_ar: بَابُ جَزَاءِ العُقُوقِ وَقَطِيعَةِ الرَّحِمِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 174
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ عُتْبَةَ ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الخَوْلَانِيِّ : عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "لَا يَدْخُلُ الجَنَّةَ عَاقٌّ، وَلَا مُدْمِنُ خَمْرٍ، وَلَا مُكَذِّبٌ بِالقَدَرِ" .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated to us Sulayman b. ‘Abd Al-Rahman Ad-Dimashqi, narrated to us Sulayman b. ‘Utbah, narrated to us Yunus b. Maysarah, from Abu Idris Al-Khawlani, from Abu Ad-Darda’, from the Prophet ﷺ who said
entries.matn_en: "The disobedient, the habitual drinker, and the one who denies predestination will not enter Paradise."

sections.title_en: The One Who Maintains Ties Is Not the One Who Merely Repays
sections.title_ar: بَابُ لَيْسَ الوَاصِلُ بِالمُكَافِئِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 177
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا الحَسَنُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الفُقَيْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُجَاهِدٌ، سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: "لَيْسَ الوَاصِلُ بِالمُكَافِئِ، وَلَكِنَّ الوَاصِلَ الَّذِي تُقْطَعُ رَحِمُهُ فَيَصِلَهَا" .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated to us Qays b. Hafs, narrated to us ‘Abd Al-Wahid, narrated to us Al-Hasan b. ‘Amr Al-Fuqaymi, narrated to us Mujahid, I heard ‘Abdullah b. ‘Amr say:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said "The one who maintains ties is not the one who merely repays. Rather, the one who maintains ties is the one whose kinship is severed, yet he maintains it."

sections.title_en: The Reward of Maintaining Kinship Ties and the Sin of Severing Them
sections.title_ar: بَابُ ثَوَاب صِلَةِ الرَّحِمِ وَإِثْمِ مَنْ قَطَعَهَا

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 178
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَرِّدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ رُومَانَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ ورَضِيَ عَنْهَا ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "الرَّحِمُ شِجْنَةٌ، فَمَنْ وَصَلَهَا وَصَلْتُهُ، وَمَنْ قَطَعَهَا قَطَعْتُهُ" .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated to us Sa‘id b. Abi Maryam, narrated to us Sulayman b. Bilal, informed me Mu‘awiyah b. Abi Muzarrid, from Yazid b. Ruman, from ‘Urwah, from ‘Aishah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ ؓ from the Prophet ﷺ who said
entries.matn_en: "Kinship is a branch. Whoever maintains it, I will maintain ties with them, and whoever severs it, I will sever ties with them."

sections.title_en: Mercy Does Not Descend Upon a People Among Whom Is One Who Severs Kinship Ties
sections.title_ar: بَابُ لَا تَنْزِلُ الرَّحْمَةُ عَلَى قَوْمٍ فِيهِمْ قَاطِعُ رَحِمٍ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 180
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، هُوَ: ابْنُ زَيْدٍ المُحَارِبِيُّ، أَبُو إِدَامٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى ﵁ : عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "إِنَّ الرَّحْمَةَ لَا تَنْزِلُ عَلَى قَوْمٍ فِيهِمْ قَاطِعُ رَحِمٍ" .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated to us ‘Ubaydullah b. Musa, informed us Sulayman, who is Ibn Zayd Al-Muharibi Abu Idam, who said: I heard ‘Abdullah b. Abi Awfa ؓ from the Prophet ﷺ who said
entries.matn_en: "Mercy does not descend upon a people among whom is one who severs kinship ties."

sections.title_en: The Humiliation That Befalls the One Who Severs Kinship Ties in the Hereafter
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مَا يَلْحَقُ قَاطِعَ الرَّحِمِ مِنَ الخِزْي فِي الآخِرَةِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 183
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ [بْنُ جُبَيْرِ] بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، أَنَّ جُبَيْرَ بْنَ مُطْعِمٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ: "لَا يَدْخُلُ الجَنَّةَ قَاطِعٌ" .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated to us ‘Abdullah b. Salih, narrated to me Al-Layth, narrated to me ‘Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, informed me Muhammad [ibn Jubayr] b. Mut‘im, that Jubayr b. Mut‘im informed him
entries.matn_en: that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say: "The one who severs ties will not enter Paradise."

sections.title_en: Whoever Maintains Their Kinship Ties, God ﷻ, Will Maintain Ties with Them
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مَنْ وَصَلَ رَحِمَهُ وَصَلَهُ اللهُ ﷻ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 184
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ النُّمَيْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الجَبَّارِ، سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ كَعْبٍ يُحَدِّثُ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "إِنَّ الرَّحِمَ شُجْنَةٌ [مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ]، تَقُولُ: يَا رَبِّ، إِنِّي قُطِعْتُ، يَا رَبِّ، ظُلِمْتُ، يَا رَبِّ، يَا رَبِّ، يَا رَبِّ، فَيُجِيبُهَا: أَلَا تَرْضَيْنَ أَنْ أَقْطَعَ مَنْ قَطَعَكِ، وَأَصِلَ مَنْ وَصَلَكِ؟ " .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated to us Hafs b. ‘Umar An-Numayri, narrated to us Shu‘bah, from Muhammad b. ‘Abd Al-Jabbar, I heard Muhammad b. Ka‘b narrate that he heard Abu Hurayrah from the Prophet ﷺ who said
entries.matn_en: "Kinship is a branch from the Most Merciful. It says: O Lord, I have been severed; O Lord, I have been wronged; O Lord, O Lord, O Lord. He responds: Are you not pleased that I sever those who sever you and maintain those who maintain you?"

sections.title_en: Admonishing the Soul to Be Dutiful to Parents and Maintain Kinship Ties
sections.title_ar: بَابُ عِظَةِ النَّفْسِ بِبِرِّ الوَالِدَيْنِ وَصِلَةِ الأَرْحَامِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 186
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ ، قَالَ: قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ التَّيْمِيُّ ؒ :
entries.matn_ar: "مَثَّلْتُ نَفْسِي فِي الجَنَّةِ، آكُلُ مِنْ طَعَامِهَا، وَأَشْرَبُ مِنْ شَرَابِهَا، وَأُجَاوِرَ مَنْ فِيهَا، وَأُصِيبُ مَا أَشْتَهِي، ثُمَّ قُلْتُ: أَيْ نَفْسُ، تَمَنِّي، قَالَتْ: أَتَمَنَّى أَنْ أَرْجِعَ إِلَى الدُّنْيَا فَأَزْدَادَ مِنَ العَمَلِ كَيْمَا أَزْدَادَ مِنَ الثَّوَابِ. ثُمَّ مَثَّلْتُ نَفْسِي فِي النَّارِ، آكُلُ مِنْ زَقُّومِهَا ، وَأَشْرَبُ مِنْ حَمِيمِهَا ، [وَأُجَاوِرَ مَنْ فِيهَا] ، ثُمَّ قُلْتُ: أَيْ نَفْسُ، تَمَنِّي، قَالَتْ: أَتَمَنَّى أَنْ أَرْجِعَ إِلَى الدُّنْيَا فَأَتُوبَ كَيْمَا أَنْجُوَ مِمَّا أَنَا فِيهِ، فَقُلْتُ لَهَا: أَيْ نَفْسُ، فَأَنْتِ فِي أُمْنِيَّتَكِ فَاعْمَلِي) .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated to us ‘Ali b. ‘Abdullah, narrated to us Sufyan, who said Ibrahim At-Taymi ؒ said:
entries.matn_en: "I imagined myself in Paradise, eating from its food, drinking from its drink, living among its inhabitants, and obtaining what I desire. Then I said: O soul, make a wish. It said: I wish to return to the world to do more deeds so that I may increase my reward. Then I imagined myself in the Fire, eating from its Zaqqūm (the bitter, cursed tree), drinking from its boiling water, [living among its inhabitants]. Then I said: O soul, make a wish. It said I wish to return to the world to repent so that I may be saved from what I am in. So I said to it: O soul, you are in your wish, so act."

sections.title_en: Compelling the Soul to Adhere to Goodness and Maintaining Ties
sections.title_ar: بَابُ حَمْلِ النَّفْسِ عَلَى مُلَازَمَةِ البِرِّ وَالصِّلَةِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 190
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ البُخَارِيُّ : حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ ، [حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ] ، عَنْ أَبِي حَيَّانَ التَّيْمِيِّ : عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: (مَا عَرَضْتُ قَوْلِي عَلَى عَمَلِي إِلَّا خَشِيتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مُكَذِّبًا) .
entries.isnad_en: Al-Bukhari said: Narrated to us Abu Nu‘aym, [narrated to us Sufyan], from Abu Hayyan At-Taymi, from Ibrahim At-Taymi, who said
entries.matn_en: "I never compared my words to my actions without fearing that I might be a liar."

sections.title_en: The Call of Parents Takes Precedence Over Voluntary Prayer
sections.title_ar: بَابُ نِدَاءِ الوَالِدَيْنِ مُقَدَّمٌ عَلَى صَلَاةِ النَّافِلَةِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 193
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ: عَنْ جَابِرٍ ﵁ ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: "إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدُكُمْ وَالإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ، فَلْيَرْكَعْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ" .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated to us Adam, narrated to us Shu‘bah, from ‘Amr b. Dinar, from Jabir ؓ
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet ﷺ said "If one of you comes while the Imam is delivering the sermon, let them pray two rak‘ahs."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 194
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ البُخَارِيُّ: "وَبِهِ نَأْخُذُ". قَالَ البُخَارِيُّ: قَالَ سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ:
entries.matn_ar: (مَنْ لَا يَعْلَمُ، وَيَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ لَا يَعْلَمُ، فَهُوَ عَالِمٌ) .
entries.isnad_en: Al-Bukhari said "And we adopt this." Al-Bukhari said: Sufyan b. ‘Uyaynah said:
entries.matn_en: "Whoever does not know and knows that they do not know is a scholar."

sections.title_en: One Should Not Show Anger Toward Their Parents
sections.title_ar: بَابُ لَا يُظْهِرُ غَضَبَهُ لِوَالِدَيْهِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 195
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ، فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَوْصِنِي وَأَقْلِلْ لَعَلِّي أَعِيَهُ، قَالَ: "لَا تَغْضَبْ ، فَسَأَلَهُ مَرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَيْنِ، كُلُّ ذَلِكَ يَقُولُ: لَا تَغْضَبْ" .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated to us Ahmad b. Humayd, narrated to us Abu Bakr, from Abu Hasin, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayrah, who said
entries.matn_en: "A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: O Messenger of God, advise me and keep it brief so I may remember it. He said: 'Do not get angry.' The man asked him once or twice, and each time he said: 'Do not get angry.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 196
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: "لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ مَنْ غَلَبَ النَّاسَ، وَلَكِنَّ الشَّدِيدَ مَنْ غَلَبَ نَفْسَهُ" .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated to us Musaddad, narrated to us Abu Al-Ahwas, from Sa‘id b. Masruq, from Abu Hazim, from Abu Hurayrah ؓ who said
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "The strong one is not the one who overpowers people, but the strong one is the one who controls their own self."

sections.title_en: Kind Words with Parents
sections.title_ar: بَابُ الكَلِمِ الطَّيِّبِ مَعَ الوَالِدَيْنِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 198
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ المُقَاتِلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا [عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ] ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: (مَكَثَ ابْنُ أَبِي نَجِيْحٍ ؒ ثَلَاثِيْنَ سَنَةً لَا يَتَكَلَّمُ بِكَلِمَةٍ يُؤذِي بِهَا جَلِيْسَه) .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated to us Muhammad b. Al-Muqatil, narrated to us [‘Abdullah b. Ibrahim b. ‘Umar b. Kaysan, from his father], who said
entries.matn_en: "Ibn Abi Najih ؒ remained for thirty years without uttering a word that would offend his companion."

sections.title_en: The Safety of Parents from Their Child
sections.title_ar: بَابُ سَلَامَةِ الوَالِدَيْنِ مِنَ الوَلَدِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 200
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَامٍ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ ، [قَالَ ]:
entries.matn_ar: (أَتَدْرُونَ مَا السَّلَامُ؟ السَّلَامُ: أَنْتَ آمِنٌ مِنِّي، أَنْتَ سَالِمٌ مِنِّي).
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. Salaam narrated from Ibn Uyaynah, [who said ]:
entries.matn_en: "Do you know what 'As-Salam' (peace) is? 'As-Salam' means: You are safe from me, you are secure from me."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 200
entries.isnad_ar: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ المُسْنَدِيَّ ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: جَاءَ سَلْمُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ إِلَى ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ ؒ، فَجَعَلَ يُسْمِعُهُ يَقُولُ: فَعَلْتَ كَذَا، وَفَعَلْتَ كَذَا، قَالَ: فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، فَقَالَ: أَشْفَانِي مِنْكَ عَقْلُكَ، قَالَ اللَّهُ ﷻ: {وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْجَاهِلِينَ}) .
entries.isnad_en: I heard Abu Abdillah al-Musnadi say:
entries.matn_en: Salm b. Salim came to Ibn Uyaynah ؒ and began saying to him: "You did such and such, you did such and such." He said Ibn Uyaynah looked at him and said "Your intellect has spared me from you." God ﷻ said: {And turn away from the ignorant.}

sections.title_en: The Matter of Parents: Kindness Toward Them
sections.title_ar: بَابُ شَأْنِ الوَالِدَيْنِ الإِحْسَانُ إِلَيْهِمَا

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 202
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنِ البَهِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ﵂،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ لَهَا: "دُونَكِ، فَانْتَصِرِي " .
entries.isnad_en: Ibrahim b. Musa narrated to us, Ibn Abi Za’idah informed us, my father informed us, from Khalid b. Salamah, from al-Bahi, from Urwah: from Aisha ؓ
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet ﷺ said to her: "Take it and seek retribution."

sections.title_en: What Has Come Regarding Informing Parents of Love for Them
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي إِعْلَامِ الحُبِّ لِلوَالِدَيْنِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 208
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ ثَوْرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي حَبِيبُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ: عَنْ المِقْدَامِ بْنِ مَعْدِي كَرِبَ ، وَكَانَ قَدْ أَدْرَكَهُ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: "إِذَا أَحَبَّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ فَلْيُعْلِمْهُ أَنَّهُ أَحَبَّهُ" .
entries.isnad_en: Musaddad narrated to us, Yahya b. Sa’id narrated to us, from Thawr, Habib b. Ubayd narrated to me: from al-Miqdam b. Ma’di Karib, who had met him, he said
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "If one of you loves his brother, let him inform him that he loves him."

sections.title_en: The Ugliness of Backbiting Parents
sections.title_ar: بَابُ قُبْحِ غِيبَةِ الوَالِدَيْنِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 210
entries.isnad_ar: سَمِعْتُ مُوسَى بْنَ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَاصِمٍ ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: (مَا اغْتَبْتُ أَحَدًا مُنْذُ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّ الغِيبَةَ تَضُرُّ أَهْلَهَا) .
entries.isnad_en: I heard Musa b. Isma’il, I heard Abu Asim say:
entries.matn_en: "I have not backbitten anyone since I learned that backbiting harms its people."

sections.title_en: Mercy Toward Parents
sections.title_ar: بَابُ الرَّحْمَةِ بِالوَالِدَيْنِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 213
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا زِيَادُ بْنُ مِخْرَاقٍ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: (قَالَ رَجُلٌ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنِّي لَأَذْبَحُ الشَّاةَ وَأَنَا أَرْحَمُهَا، أَوْ: إِنِّي لَأَرْحَمُ الشَّاةَ أَنْ أَذْبَحَهَا، قَالَ: "وَالشَّاةُ إِنْ رَحِمْتَهَا، رَحِمَكَ اللَّهُ" مَرَّتَيْنِ) .
entries.isnad_en: Musaddad narrated to us, Isma’il b. Ibrahim narrated to us, Ziyad b. Mikhraq narrated to us, from Mu’awiyah b. Qurrah, from his father, who said
entries.matn_en: A man said: "O Messenger of God, I slaughter the sheep while I have mercy on it," or: "I have mercy on the sheep from slaughtering it." He said: "As for the sheep, if you have mercy on it, God will have mercy on you," twice.

sections.title_en: From the Perfection of Kindness: Good Character with Parents
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مِنْ تَمَامِ البِرِّ حُسْنُ الخُلُقِ مَعَ الوَالِدَيْنِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 216
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ المُنْذِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنٌ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ: عَنْ نَوَّاسِ بْنِ سَمْعَانَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ ،
entries.matn_ar: (أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ البِرِّ وَالإِثْمِ؟ فَقَالَ: "البِرُّ حُسْنُ [الخُلُقِ] ، وَالإِثْمُ مَا حَكَّ فِي نَفْسِكَ فَكَرِهْتَ أَنْ يَطَّلِعَ عَلَيْهِ النَّاسُ") .
entries.isnad_en: Ibrahim b. al-Mundhir narrated to us, Ma’n narrated to us, from Mu’awiyah, from Abd al-Rahman b. Jubayr b. Nufayr, from his father: from Nawwas b. Sam’an al-Ansari,
entries.matn_en: that he asked the Messenger of God ﷺ about kindness and sin. He said "Kindness is good character, and sin is what troubles your soul, and you would hate for people to become aware of it."

sections.title_en: Among the Trials of the Last Days: Disobedience and Severing Ties of Kinship
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مِنْ فِتَنِ آخِرِ الزَّمَانِ، العُقُوقُ وَقَطْعُ الرَّحِمِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 218
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو اليَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي سَالِمٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَهُوَ عَلَى المِنْبَرِ يَقُولُ: "أَلَا إِنَّ الفِتْنَةَ هُنَا" يُشِيرُ إِلَى المَشْرِقِ "مِنْ حَيْثُ يَطْلُعُ قَرْنُ الشَّيْطَانِ" .
entries.isnad_en: Abu al-Yaman narrated to us, Shu’ayb informed us, from al-Zuhri, Salim narrated to me, from his father, who said:
entries.matn_en: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ while he was on the pulpit, saying: "Indeed, the trial is here," pointing toward the east, "from where the horn of Satan rises."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 219
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ﵃، عَنْ أَبِيهِ:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَامَ يَخْطُبُ النَّاسَ، فَقَالَ: "إِنَّ الفِتْنَةَ هَا هُنَا، مِنْ حَيْثُ يَطْلُعُ قَرْنُ الشَّيْطَانِ ". يَعْنِي: المَشْرِقَ .
entries.isnad_en: Abdillah b. Salih narrated to me, al-Layth narrated to me, Uqayl narrated to me, from Ibn Shihab, Salim b. Abdillah b. Umar ؓ informed me, from his father:
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ stood delivering a sermon to the people and said "Indeed, the trial is here, from where the horn of Satan rises." Meaning: the east.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 220
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حَاطِبٍ: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، قَالَ: (قَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ ﵁ :
entries.matn_ar: لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ: {ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ} . قَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، يُكَرِّرُ عَلَيْنَا الخُصُومَةَ بَعْدَ الَّذِي كَانَ لَنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا، قَالَ: "نَعَمْ". قُلْتُ: إِنَّ الأَمْرَ لَشَدِيدٌ .
entries.isnad_en: Al-Humaydi narrated to us, Sufyan narrated to us, Muhammad b. ‘Amr b. ‘Alqamah narrated to us, from Yahya b. ‘Abd al-Rahman b. Hatib: from ‘Abd Allah b. al-Zubayr, who said (Az-Zubayr ؓ said:
entries.matn_en: When the verse was revealed: {Then indeed, you on the Day of Resurrection before your Lord will dispute} [Az-Zumar: 31], Az-Zubayr said: 'O Messenger of God, will the disputes we had in this world be repeated for us?' He said: 'Yes.' I said: 'Then the matter is indeed severe.')

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 223
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللهِ أَبُو ثَابِتٍ المَدَنِيُّ، قَالَ [حَدَّثَنَا] عُمَرُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ الوَقَّاصِيُّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، [قَالَ]: سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: (لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ: {ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ} . قَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، يُكَرَّرُ عَلَيْنَا مَا كَانَ مِنَّا فِي الدُّنْيَا، مَعَ خَوَاصِّ الذُّنُوبِ؟ قَالَ: "نَعَمْ. لَيُكَرَّرَنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ، حَتَّى يُؤَدَّى إِلَى كُلِّ ذِي حَقٍّ حَقَّهُ". قَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ ﵁: وَاللَّهِ إِنَّ الأَمْرَ لَشَدِيدٌ) . قَالَ البُخَارِيُّ: "وَرَوَاهُ حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ حَبِيبٍ، عَنِ الحَسَنِ، قَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ. وَرَوَاهُ شَدَّادُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ غَيْلَانَ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ، وَأَلفَاظُهُمْ مُتَقَارِبَةٌ، وَالصَّحِيحُ حَدِيثُ الأَوَّلِ" .
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. ‘Ubayd Allāh Abu Thabit al-Madani narrated to us, he said ‘Umar b. Talhah al-Waqqasi narrated to us, from Muhammad b. ‘Amr, from Yahya b. ‘Abd al-Rahman, [who said]: I heard ‘Abd Allah b. al-Zubayr say:
entries.matn_en: (When the verse was revealed: {Then indeed, you on the Day of Resurrection before your Lord will dispute} [Az-Zumar: 31], Az-Zubayr said: 'O Messenger of God, will what occurred between us in this world be repeated, along with the specific sins?' He said: 'Yes, it will indeed be repeated for you until every rightful person receives their right.' Az-Zubayr ؓ said: 'By God, the matter is indeed severe.') Al-Bukhari said 'And it was narrated by Hammad b. Salamah, from Habib, from al-Hasan, that Az-Zubayr said. It was also narrated by Shaddad b. Sa‘id, from Ghaylan, from Mutarrif, who said: Az-Zubayr said. Their wordings are similar, and the correct narration is the first one.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 224
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ القُمِّيُّ ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرٌ، هُوَ: ابْنُ [أَبِي] المُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: (لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ: {ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ} . لَمْ نَدْرِ مَا تَفْسِيرُهَا؟ فَلَمَّا وَقَعَتِ الفِتْنَةُ، قُلْنَا هَذَا الَّذِي وَعَدَنَا رَبُّنَا أَنْ نَخْتَصِمَ فِيهِ) .
entries.isnad_en: Abu al-Rabi‘ Sulayman b. Dawud narrated to us, Ya‘qub al-Qummi narrated to us, Ja‘far—who is Ibn Abi al-Mughirah—narrated to us, from Sa‘id b. Jubayr: from Ibn ‘Umar, who said:
entries.matn_en: (When the verse was revealed: {Then indeed, you on the Day of Resurrection before your Lord will dispute} [Az-Zumar: 31], we did not know its interpretation. When the tribulation occurred, we said 'This is what our Lord promised us, that we would dispute over it.')

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 226
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ: عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ: "هَلْ تَرَوْنَ مَا أَرَى؟ أَرَى الفِتَنَ تَقَعُ خِلَالَ بُيُوتِكُمْ" .
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. Kathir narrated to us, Sulayman b. Kathir informed us, from az-Zuhri, from ‘Urwah: from Usamah b. Zayd,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet ﷺ said 'Do you see what I see? I see tribulations falling through your houses.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 228
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا الفَضْلُ بْنُ دُكَيْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ: عَنْ أُسَامَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: "هَلْ تَرَوْنَ مَا أَرَى؟ إِنِّي لأَرَى مَوَاقِعَ الفِتَنِ خِلَالَ بُيُوتِكُمْ كَمَوَاقِعِ القَطْرِ " .
entries.isnad_en: Al-Fadl b. Dukayn narrated to us, Ibn ‘Uyaynah narrated to us, from az-Zuhri, from ‘Urwah: from Usamah, who said
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Do you see what I see? Indeed, I see the places where tribulations will fall through your houses like the falling of rain.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 229
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَانُ ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ: عَنْ كُرْزِ بْنِ عَلْقَمَةَ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: (قَالَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ: لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ: هَلْ لِلإِسْلَامِ مُنْتَهًى؟ قَالَ: "نَعَمْ، أَيُّمَا أَهْلِ بَيْتٍ مِنَ العَرَبِ، أَوِ العَجَمِ، أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِهِمْ خَيْرًا أَدْخَلَ عَلَيْهِمُ الإِسْلَامَ، ثُمَّ تَقَعُ الفِتَنُ كَأَنَّهَا الظُلَمُ". فَقَالَ الأَعْرَابِيُّ: كَلَّا، قَالَ: "بَلَى، وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، ثُمَّ تَعُودُنَّ فِيهَا أَسَاوِدَ صُبًّا ، يَضْرِبُ بَعْضُكُمْ رِقَابَ بَعْضٍ " .
entries.isnad_en: ‘Abdan narrated to us, ‘Abd Allah narrated to us, Ma‘mar informed us, from az-Zuhri, from ‘Urwah: from Kurz b. ‘Alqamah, who said
entries.matn_en: (A Bedouin said to the Prophet ﷺ: 'Is there an end to Islam?' He said: 'Yes. Any household among the Arabs or non-Arabs for whom God intends good, He admits Islam to them; then trials will fall like patches of darkness.' The Bedouin said: 'Never!' He said: 'Indeed, by the One in Whose Hand is my soul, you will then return to it as serpents pouring down, some of you striking the necks of others.')

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 234
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَهُوَ مُسْتَقْبِلٌ المَشْرِقَ يَقُولُ: "أَلَا إِنَّ الفِتْنَةَ هَا هُنَا، أَلَا إِنَّ الفِتْنَةَ مِنْ هَا هُنَا، مِنْ حَيْثُ يَطْلُعُ قَرْنُ الشَّيْطَانِ" .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated ‘Abdullah b. Salih: Layth narrated to me, from Nafi‘, from ‘Abdullah (ibn ‘Umar),
entries.matn_en: that he heard the Messenger of God ﷺ while he was facing the east, say: "Behold! The trial is here—behold! The trial is from here, from where the horn of Satan rises."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 235
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الجَرْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعٌ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَهُ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ
entries.matn_ar: نَحْوَهُ .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated Sa‘id b. Muhammad al-Jarmi: Ya‘qub b. Ibrahim narrated to us, from his father, from Salih, from Nafi‘, that ‘Abdullah informed him from the Prophet ﷺ
entries.matn_en: similarly.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 236
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: (رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُشِيرُ إِلَى المَشْرِقِ، يَقُولُ: "إِنَّ الفِتْنَةَ مِنْ هَا هُنَا، إِنَّ الفِتْنَةَ مِنْ حَيْثُ يَطْلُعُ قَرْنُ الشَّيْطَانِ") .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated Khalid b. Makhlad: Sulayman b. Bilal narrated to us, ‘Abdullah b. Dinar reported to us, from Ibn ‘Umar ؓ who said
entries.matn_en: I saw the Messenger of God ﷺ pointing toward the east, saying: "The trial is from here, the trial is from where the horn of Satan rises."

sections.title_en: The Swift Punishment in This World for the One Who Cuts Off Kinship Ties
sections.title_ar: بَابُ تَعْجِيلِ عُقُوبَةِ قَاطِعِ الرَّحِمِ فِي الدُّنْيَا

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 237
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عُيَيْنَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ: عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: "مَا مِنْ ذَنْبٍ أَحْرَى أَنْ يُعَجِّلَ اللَّهُ لِصَاحِبِهِ العُقُوبَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا، مَعَ مَا يَدَّخِرُ لَهُ فِي الآخِرَةِ، مِنْ قَطِيعَةِ الرَّحِمِ وَالبَغْيِ" .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated Adam b. Abi Iyas: Shu‘bah narrated to us, from ‘Uyaynah b. ‘Abd al-Rahman, who heard his father narrating from Abu Bakrah, who said
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "There is no sin more deserving of God hastening punishment in this world, along with what He has stored for its doer in the Hereafter, than severing kinship ties and oppression."

sections.title_en: The One Who Maintains Ties of Kinship Will Always Have Support from God ﷻ
sections.title_ar: بَابُ لَا يَزَالُ للوَاصِلِ ظَهِيرٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ ﷻ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 241
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنِ العَلَاءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَتَى رَجُلٌ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَ: إِنَّ لِي قَرَابَةً أَصِلُهُمْ وَيَقْطَعُونَ، وَأَحْلُمُ عَنْهُمْ وَيَجْهَلُونَ عَلَيَّ، وَأُحْسِنُ إِلَيْهِمْ وَيُسِيئُونَ إِلَيَّ، قَالَ: "لَئِنْ كَانَ كَمَا تَقُولُ كَأَنَّمَا تُسِفُّهُمُ المَلَّ ، وَلَا يَزَالُ مَعَكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ ظَهِيرٌ [عَلَيْهِمْ] مَا دُمْتَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ") .
entries.isnad_en: Umayyah b. Bistam narrated to us, Yazid b. Zuray‘ narrated to us, from al-‘Ala’, from his father: from Abu Hurayrah, who said
entries.matn_en: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: 'I have relatives whom I maintain ties with, but they sever them; I overlook their faults, but they treat me with ignorance; I treat them well, but they treat me badly.' He said: 'If what you say is true, it is as if you are feeding them hot ashes, and you will always have support from God against them as long as you persist in this.'

sections.title_en: Knowing Who Truly Maintains Ties
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مَعْرِفَةِ الوَاصِلِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 243
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، وَالحَسَنِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، وَفِطْرٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ سُفْيَانُ: وَلَمْ يَرْفَعْهُ الأَعْمَشُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ، وَرَفَعَهُ الحَسَنُ وَفِطْرٌ، إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "لَيْسَ الوَاصِلُ بِالمُكَافِئِ، وَلَكِنَّ الوَاصِلَ الَّذِي تَوَلَّتْ رَحِمُهُ وَصَلَهَا" .
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. Kathir narrated to us, Sufyan narrated to us, from al-A‘mash, al-Hasan b. ‘Amr, and Fitr, from Mujahid, from ‘Abdullah b. ‘Amr, who said Sufyan said: Al-A‘mash did not attribute it to the Prophet ﷺ but al-Hasan and Fitr did. He said:
entries.matn_en: 'The one who maintains ties is not the one who merely reciprocates; rather, the one who maintains ties is the one whose relatives turn away from him and he still keeps ties with them.'

sections.title_en: The Virtue of One Who Maintains Ties with an Oppressive Relative
sections.title_ar: بَابُ فَضْلِ مَنْ يَصِلُ ذَا الرَّحِمِ الظَّالِمِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 244
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْسَجَةَ: عَنِ البَرَاءِ ﵁ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: (جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ فَقَالَ: يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ، عَلِّمْنِي عَمَلًا يُدْخِلُنِي الجَنَّةَ، قَالَ: "لَئِنْ كُنْتَ أَقَصَرْتَ الخُطْبَةَ لَقَدْ أَعْرَضْتَ المَسْأَلَةَ ، أَعْتِقِ النَّسَمَةَ ، وَفُكَّ الرَّقَبَةَ". قَالَ: أَوَ لَيْسَتَا وَاحِدًا ؟ قَالَ: "لَا، عِتْقُ النَّسَمَةِ أَنْ تَعْتِقَ النَّسَمَةَ ، وَفَكُّ الرَّقَبَةِ أَنْ تُعِينَ عَلَى الرَّقَبَةِ ، وَالمَنِيحَةُ الوَكُوفُ ، وَالفَيْءُ عَلَى ذِي الرَّحِمِ الظَّالِمِ ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تُطِقْ [ذَلِكَ]، فَتَأْمُرَ بِالمَعْرُوفِ، وَانْهَ عَنِ المُنْكَرِ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تُطِقْ [ذَلِكَ]، فَكُفَّ لِسَانَكَ إِلَّا مِنْ خَيْرٍ") .
entries.isnad_en: Malik b. Isma‘il narrated to us, ‘Isa b. ‘Abd al-Rahman narrated to us, from Talhah, from ‘Abd al-Rahman b. ‘Awsajah: from al-Bara’ ؓ who said
entries.matn_en: A Bedouin came and said: 'O Prophet of God, teach me a deed that will admit me to Paradise.' He said: 'Though you have kept your words short, you have asked a vast question. Free a soul and release a neck.' He said: 'Are they not the same?' He said: 'No. Freeing a soul is to free a person yourself; releasing a neck is to help pay for the freeing. And [give] the loan of a richly milking animal (al-minḥa al-wakūf), and return kindness to the wrongdoing relative. If you cannot do that, then enjoin good and forbid evil. If you cannot do that, then restrain your tongue except from what is good.'

sections.title_en: Whoever Embraces Islam Retains the Reward of His Past Good Deeds and Maintaining Ties of Kinship
sections.title_ar: بَابُ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ عَلَى مَا سَلَفَ لَهُ مِنَ البِرِّ وَصِلَةِ الرَّحِمِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 247
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو اليَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ حَكِيمَ بْنَ حِزَامٍ ، أَخْبَرَهُ:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ: (أَرَأَيْتَ أُمُورًا كُنْتُ أَتَحَنَّثُ، أَوْ أَتَحَنَّتُ بِهَا فِي الجَاهِلِيَّةِ، مِنْ صِلَةٍ وَعَتَاقَةٍ وَصَدَقَةٍ، هَلْ لِي فِيهَا أَجْرٌ؟ قَالَ حَكِيمٌ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: "أَسْلَمْتَ عَلَى مَا سَلَفَ مِنْ خَيْرٍ") .
entries.isnad_en: Abu al-Yaman narrated to us, Shu‘ayb informed us, from al-Zuhri, ‘Urwah b. al-Zubayr informed me that Hakim b. Hizam informed him:
entries.matn_en: that he said to the Messenger of God ﷺ: 'Do you see the deeds I used to perform in the pre-Islamic era, such as maintaining ties of kinship, freeing slaves, and giving charity—will I have a reward for them?' Hakim said The Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'You have embraced Islam with the good you had previously done.'

sections.title_en: The Virtue of Spending and Charity on Relatives, Spouses, Children, and Parents
sections.title_ar: بَابُ فَضْلِ النَّفَقَةِ وَالصَّدَقَةِ عَلَى الأَقْرَبِينَ وَالزَّوْجِ وَالأَوْلَادِ وَالوَالِدَيْنِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 253
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ شَرِيكٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ: عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ ﵂:
entries.matn_ar: "أنَّها أَعْتَقَتْ جَارِيَةً لَهَا، فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَذَكَرَتْ لَهُ، فَقَالَ: قَدْ آجَرَكِ اللهُ، أَمَا إِنَّكِ لَوْ أَعْطَيْتِهَا أَخْوَالَكِ، كَانَ أَعْظَمَ لِأَجْرِكِ" .
entries.isnad_en: ‘Abd al-Rahman b. Sharik narrated to us, his father narrated to us, from Muhammad b. Ishaq, from Bukayr b. ‘Abdullah b. al-Ashajj, from Sulayman b. Yasar: from Maymunah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ and ؓ:
entries.matn_en: that she freed a slave girl of hers. The Messenger of God ﷺ entered upon her and she mentioned it to him. He said 'God has rewarded you. If you had given her to your maternal uncles, your reward would have been greater.'

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 257
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنِي بَكْرُ بْنُ مُضَرَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، وَهُوَ: ابْنُ الحَارِثِ، عَنْ بُكَيْرٍ: عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ:
entries.matn_ar: (أَنَّ مَيْمُونَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ، أَعْتَقَتْ وَلِيدَةً لَهَا، فَقَالَ لَهَا: "لَوْ وَصَلْتِ بَعْضَ أَخْوَالِكِ كَانَ أَعْظَمَ لِأَجْرِكِ") .
entries.isnad_en: ‘Abdullah b. Salih narrated to us, Bakr b. Mudar narrated to me, from ‘Amr, who is Ibn al-Harith, from Bukayr: from Kurayb, the freed slave of Ibn ‘Abbas:
entries.matn_en: that Maymunah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ freed a slave girl of hers. He said to her: 'If you had given her to some of your maternal uncles, your reward would have been greater.'

sections.title_en: The Kinship Seeks Refuge in the Creator, Glorified and Exalted, from Being Severed
sections.title_ar: بَابُ تَعَوُّذِ الرَّحِمِ بِالبَارِي جل جلاله مِنَ القَطِيعَةِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 260
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَرِّدٍ، سَمِعْتُ عَمِّي سَعِيدَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ، يُحَدِّثُ: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ الخَلْقَ، حَتَّى إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ، قَالَتِ الرَّحِمُ: هَذَا مَقَامُ العَائِذِ بِكَ مِنَ القَطِيعَةِ، قَالَ: نَعَمْ، أَلَا تَرْضَيْنَ أَنْ أَصِلَ مَنْ وَصَلَكِ، وَأَقْطَعَ مَنْ قَطَعَكِ؟ قَالَتْ: بَلَى يَا رَبِّ، قَالَ: فَهُوَ لَكِ". قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: "فَاقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ": {فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ أَنْ تُفْسِدُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوا أَرْحَامَكُمْ (22) أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمْ وَأَعْمَى أَبْصَارَهُمْ} " .
entries.isnad_en: Bishr b. Muhammad narrated to us, ‘Abdullah informed us, Mu‘awiyah b. Abi Muzarrad informed us, I heard my uncle Sa‘id b. Yasar narrating: from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet ﷺ who said
entries.matn_en: 'God created the creation, and when He finished, the kinship said: This is the station of the one seeking refuge in You from being severed. He said: Yes, are you not pleased that I maintain ties with those who maintain ties with you and sever ties with those who sever ties with you? She said: Yes, O Lord. He said: That is for you.' The Messenger of God ﷺ said: 'Recite if you wish: {Would you then, if you were given authority, cause corruption in the land and sever your ties of kinship? Those are the ones whom God has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their eyes.} [Muhammad: 22-23]'

sections.title_en: Righteousness and Maintaining Ties Are a Cause of Safety
sections.title_ar: بَابُ البِرِّ وَالصِّلَةِ سَبَبٌ لِلسَّلَامَةِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 262
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، سَمِعْتُ عُرْوَةَ، يَقُولُ: قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ ﵂:
entries.matn_ar: (فَرَجَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلَى خَدِيجَةَ ﵂ ، تَرْجُفُ بَوَادِرُهُ ، فَدَخَلَ وَقَالَ: "زَمِّلُونِي زَمِّلُونِي "، فَلَمَّا سُرِّيَ عَنْهُ، قَالَ ﷺ لِخَدِيجَةَ: أَشْفَقْتُ عَلَى نَفْسِي، قَالَتْ خَدِيجَةُ ﵂: أَبْشِرْ، فَوَاللَّهِ لَا يُخْزِيكَ اللَّهُ أَبَدًا، إِنَّكَ لَتَصْدُقُ الحَدِيثَ، وَتَصِلُ الرَّحِمَ، وَتَحْمِلُ الكَلَّ ، وَتَقْرِي الضَّيْفَ ، وَتُعِينُ عَلَى نَوَائِبِ الحَقِّ ، فَانْطَلَقَتْ بِهِ خَدِيجَةُ إِلَى وَرَقَةَ بْنِ نَوْفَلِ بْنِ أَسَدٍ، وَكَانَ تَنَصَّرَ، شَيْخٌ أَعْمَى، يَقْرَأُ الإِنْجِيلَ بِالعَرَبِيَّةِ، [فَـ] قَالَتْ لَهُ خَدِيجَةُ: أَيْ عَمِّ، اسْمَعْ مِنَ ابْنِ أَخِيكَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ وَرَقَةُ: يَا ابْنَ أَخِي مَاذَا تَرَى؟ فَأَخْبَرَهُ خَبَرَ مَا رَأَى، فَقَالَ وَرَقَةُ: هَذَا النَّامُوسُ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ اللهُ عَلَى مُوسَى، يَا لَيْتَنِي فِيهَا جَذَعًا ، يَا لَيْتَنِي أَكُونُ حَيًّا حِينَ يُخْرِجُكَ قَوْمُكَ، قَالَ: "أَوَ مُخْرِجِيَّ هُمْ؟ " قَالَ: نَعَمْ، لَمْ يَأْتِ رَجُلٌ [بِـ] مَا جِئْتَ بِهِ قَطُّ إِلَّا عُودِيَ، وَإِنْ يُدْرِكْنِي يَوْمُكَ أَنْصُرْكَ نَصْرًا مُؤَزَّرًا) .
entries.isnad_en: ‘Abdullah b. Yusuf narrated to us, al-Layth narrated to us, from ‘Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab, I heard ‘Urwah say: ‘A’ishah ؓ said
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ returned to Khadijah ؓ his limbs trembling. He entered and said: 'Wrap me up, wrap me up.' When his fear subsided, he said to Khadijah: 'I feared for myself.' Khadijah ؓ said: 'Rejoice, for by God, God will never disgrace you. You speak the truth, maintain ties of kinship, bear the burdens of others, honor the guest, and assist in matters of truth.' Then Khadijah took him to Waraqah b. Nawfal b. Asad, who had embraced Christianity. He was an old, blind man who read the Gospel in Arabic. Khadijah said to him: 'O uncle, listen to your nephew.' Waraqah said to him: 'O son of my brother, what do you see?' He informed him of what he had seen. Waraqah said: 'This is the Namus whom God sent to Moses. I wish I were young; I wish I were alive when your people drive you out.' He said: 'Will they drive me out?' He said: 'Yes, no man has ever come with what you have brought except that he was opposed. If I live to see your day, I will support you with strong support.'

sections.title_en: Righteousness Toward the Closest Relatives First
sections.title_ar: بَابُ بِرِّ الأَقْرَبِ فَالأَقْرَبِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 266
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا الوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ العَلَاءِ، وَغَيْرُهُ ، أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا بِلَالَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ﵃ :
entries.matn_ar: "أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَا لِلخَلِيفَةِ مِنْ بَعْدِكِ؟ قَالَ: "مِثْلُ الَّذِي لِي، مَا عَدْلَ فِي الحَكَمِ، وَقَسَطَ فِي البَسْطِ ، وَرَحِمَ ذَا الرَّحِمِ، فَمَنْ فَعَلَ غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّي، وَلَسْتُ مِنْهُ". قَالَ: يُرِيدُ الطَّاعَةَ فِي طَاعَةِ اللهِ، وَالمَعْصِيَةَ فِي مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ ﷻ .
entries.isnad_en: Sulayman b. ‘Abd al-Rahman narrated to us, al-Walid b. Muslim narrated to us, ‘Abdullah b. al-‘Ala’ and others narrated to us, that they heard Bilal b. Sa‘d, from his father ؓ:
entries.matn_en: That he said: 'O Messenger of God, what [reward] does the caliph have after you?' He said: 'The like of what I have, so long as he is just in judgment, fair in distribution, and merciful to those of his kin. Whoever does otherwise is not from me, and I am not from him.' The narrator said: he means obedience [to the caliph] in what is obedience to God, and disobedience in what is disobedience to God ﷻ.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 273
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ: عَنْ جَابِرٍ ﵁، أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَعْتَقَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي عُذْرَةَ عَبْدًا لَهُ عَنْ دُبُرٍ ، فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ: "لَكَ مَالٌ غَيْرُهُ؟ " فَقَالَ: لَا، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: "مَنْ يَشْتَرِيهِ مِنِّي"، فَاشْتَرَاهُ نُعَيْمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللهِ النَّحَّامُ ، بِثَمَانِ مِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ، فَجَاءَ بِهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ، فَدَفَعَهَا إِلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: "ابْدَأْ بِنَفْسِكَ فَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيْهَا، فَإِنْ فَضَلَ شَيْءٌ [فَلِأَهْلِكَ، فَإِنْ فَضَلَ عَنْ أَهْلِكَ شَيْءٌ فَلِذِي قَرَابَتِكَ، فَإِنْ فَضَلَ] عَنْ [ذِي] قَرَابَتِكَ [شَيْءٌ] ، فَهَكَذَا، وَهَكَذَا "، يَقُولُ: بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ وَعَنْ يَمِينِكَ وَعَنْ شِمَالِكَ) .
entries.isnad_en: Qutaybah b. Sa‘eed narrated to us, Al-Layth narrated to us, from Abu Az-Zubayr, from Jaabir ؓ that he said
entries.matn_en: A man from Banu ‘Udhrah emancipated a slave of his upon his death. This reached the Messenger of God ﷺ so he said: "Do you have any wealth besides him?" The man said: No. The Messenger of God ﷺ then said: "Who will buy him from me?" So Nu‘aym b. ‘Abdullah An-Nahhaam bought him for eight hundred dirhams. He brought the money to the Messenger of God ﷺ and he gave it to him. Then he said "Begin with yourself and give charity to it. If anything remains, then for your family. If anything remains after your family, then for your relatives. If anything remains after your relatives, then like this and like this," meaning: in front of you, to your right, and to your left.

sections.title_en: The Manifestation of Severing Kinship Ties in the Latter Days
sections.title_ar: بَابُ ظُهُورِ قَطْعِ الأَرْحَامِ فِي آخِرِ الزَّمَانِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 276
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سَمْعَانَ : سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁:
entries.matn_ar: "يَتَعَوَّذُ مِنْ إِمَارَةِ الصِّبْيَانِ وَالسُّفَهَاءِ" . فَقَالَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ سَمْعَانَ: فَأَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ حَسَنَةَ الجُهَنِيُّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ: مَا آيَةُ ذَلِكَ؟، قَالَ: أَنْ تُقْطَعَ الأَرْحَامُ، وَيُطَاعَ المُغْوِي، وَيُعْصَى المُرْشِدُ .
entries.isnad_en: Aadam b. Abi Iyaas narrated to us, Shu‘bah narrated to us. Ibn Abi Dhi’b said Sa‘eed b. Sam‘aan narrated to us: I heard Abu Hurayrah ؓ
entries.matn_en: seeking refuge from the rule of boys and fools. Sa‘eed b. Sam‘aan said: Ibn Hasanah Al-Juhani informed me that he said to Abu Hurayrah: What is the sign of that? He said: When kinship ties are severed, the misguiding are obeyed, and the rightly guided are disobeyed.

sections.title_en: Kinship Is Kept Moist with Its Moisture
sections.title_ar: بَابُ تُبَلُّ الرَّحِمُ بِبَلَالِهَا

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 286
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الوَاحِدِ بْنِ عَنْبَسَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنِي جَدِّي، عَنْ بَيَانِ بْنِ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ: عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ العَاصِ ﵁ ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: (سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُنَادِي جِهَارًا غَيْرَ سِرٍّ : "إِنَّمَا وَلِيِّيَ اللَّهُ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا، وَلَكِنْ لَهُمْ رَحِمٌ سَأَبُلُّهَا بِبَلَالِهَا") .
entries.isnad_en: Muhammad b. ‘Abd al-Wahid b. ‘Anbasah b. ‘Abd al-Wahid narrated to us, my grandfather narrated to me, from Bayan b. Bishr, from Qays b. Abi Hazim, from ‘Amr b. al-‘As ؓ who said:
entries.matn_en: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ proclaiming openly, not secretly, 'Indeed, my protector is God and those who believe; but they have a tie of kinship, and I will moisten it with its moisture [that is, maintain it].'

sections.title_en: Caution Against a Man Prioritizing His Wife Over His Parents
sections.title_ar: بَابُ الحَذَرِ مِنْ أَنْ يُقَدِّمَ الرَّجُلُ زَوْجَتَهُ عَلَى وَالِدَيْهِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 290
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيَّ: عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: "مَا تَرَكْتُ بَعْدِي فِتْنَةً أَضَرَّ عَلَى الرِّجَالِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ" .
entries.isnad_en: Narrated to us Aadam b. Abee Iyaas, narrated to us Shu'bah, from Sulaymaan at-Taymee, who said: I heard Abu Uthmaan an-Nahdee: from Usaamah b. Zayd, from the Prophet ﷺ who said
entries.matn_en: "I have not left behind after me a trial more harmful to men than women.".

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Birr al-Wālidayn of al-Bukhārī · Vol. 1, p. 291
entries.matn_ar: آخِرُ الكِتَابِ، وَالحَمْدُ للَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ. عَلَّقَهُ لِنَفْسِهِ العَبْدُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ مَنْصُورٍ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ الحُسَيْنِيُّ الحَلَبِيُّ، نَهَارَ الثُّلَاثَاءِ 28 شَوَّالٍ، سَنَةَ 887، بِعُلُوِّ جَامِعِ الأَزْهَرِ بِالقَاهِرَةِ، حَمَاهَا اللَّهُ تَعَالَى. اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، وَآلِه وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّم .
entries.matn_en: The end of the book, and all praise is due to God in every circumstance. Noted for himself the servant Muhammad b. Muhammad Mansoor b. Alee al-Husaynee al-Halabee, on the day of Tuesday, the 28th of Shawwaal, in the year 887, at the upper part of al-Azhar Mosque in Cairo, may God ﷻ protect it. O God, send prayers upon our master Muhammad, and his family and companions, and grant them peace.
